==Use==
 <nowiki>{</nowiki>{'''UnitsNavbox'''|title=''Infobox title''|l=''Language code''|collapsed=''Any text''}}
*<code>''Infobox title''</code> — automatic translation for the infobox title is not provided, so it must be entered every time when calling the template.
*<code>''Any text''</code> — enter any text to make the navbox collapsed by default; ignore this parameter to make the navbox expanded by default.
{{LanguageCodesNote}}
==Examples==
<pre>{{UnitsNavbox|collapsed=1}}</pre>
{{UnitsNavbox|collapsed=1}}
<pre>{{UnitsNavbox|title=[[Существа]]|l=ru|t=1|collapsed=1}}</pre>
{{UnitsNavbox|title=[[Существа]]|l=ru|t=1|collapsed=1}}
<pre>{{UnitsNavbox|title=[[Units/pl|Jednostki]]|l=pl|collapsed=1}}</pre>
{{UnitsNavbox|title=[[Units/pl|Jednostki]]|l=pl|collapsed=1}}
